'''Candra Tymon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as [[Chief of Security/Legends|Chief of Security]] for [[Adan Dooku]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]]. Her [[Candra Tymon's father|father]] was Dooku's previous head of security and she took her duties very seriously.

==Biography==
[[Candra Tymon's father|Candra's father]] was Chief of Security of Adan Dooku before her. Dooku appointed her as her father's successor, despite the fact that many on Serenno, including her father, doubted a woman could lead a [[House Dooku security team|security team]].<ref name="Hard Targets, Part 4" />

During a private meeting between Dooku and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] in the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace]], she stepped out on a balcony. She noticed the flash from a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper's]] [[Scope/Legends|scope]] and attempted to throw herself in front of the shot. Unfortunately, Tymon was too slow and was unable to prevent the assassination of Dooku. She gave pursuit to the assassin and was able to get off a couple of shots at him. Due to the assassin's [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]], she was unable to take him down and watched him escape as she dangled from a broken ladder that the assassin had shot out from underneath her.<ref name="Hard Targets, Part 1">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 1|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 1]]</ref>

Tymon then oversaw the security at the [[Great Assembly House/Legends|Great Assembly House]] on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] as the Six lords of the major houses tried to choose a new regent to become the new Count Dooku. Later, she oversaw security and the protection [[Bron Dooku]] onboard the [[Windrunner/Legends|''Windrunner'']]. She defended the young Count and the other lords when they came under attack from [[Aveca Dunn]], Captain [[Ramchak]] and his pirate crew of the ''[[Bloodskull]]''.<ref name="Hard Targets, Part 2">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 2|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 2]]</ref> Though she was able to make them surrender, Bron was kidnapped by Dunn. She remained onboard and directed the repairs on the ''Windrunner''.<ref name="Hard Targets, Part 3">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 3|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 3]]</ref>

Tymon contacted Imperial Envoy [[Jahan Cross]] for help in rescuing the young count. Tymon told Cross that Dunn was taken to [[Spike (Serenno)/Legends|the Spike]] and that she was going interrogate her once she woke up. She went to the Spike to meet with warden [[Gundren]] about speaking with Dunn. While speaking with him, the power went down. Tymon grabbed a blaster and went down to check on Dunn. When she saw Dunn in a guard uniform, she was knocked out by Cross, also in a guards uniform. She was then left by Dunn and Cross to be taken to a [[Serenno med center|med center]].<ref name="Hard Targets, Part 3" /> The [[Serenno security forces|security forces]] removed Tymon from her position as Chief of Security of [[House Dooku]] due to her inability to protect Bron and the fact that Vex, Dooku's kidnapper, escaped from her [[Prison/Legends|prison]].<ref name="Hard Targets, Part 4" />

Tymon later met up with Cross at the [[Diner Port]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] near the [[Carannia Spaceport/Legends|Serenno Spaceport]]. When Cross told Tymon about how he freed Vex, she attacked Cross, wanting to kill him. She continued to fight him even when Cross told her that it was Duke [[Rodas Borgin]] who hired Vex. It was only after that she realized that she had to protect Bron. She piloted the [[bongo]] that carried her and Cross to [[Otoh Dooku]] to pick up the boy. Tymon infiltrated the underwater base with Cross and went with him to the room where Bron was being held. After Cross disabled the [[Unidentified MK 8001 Attendant Droid|MK 8001 Attendant Droid]] that was guarding Bron, Tymon fitted her and Bron with [[Rebreather/Legends|rebreathers]] and swam to the bongo as Cross drew off security by fleeing in a [[Manta droid subfighter]]. On the submersible, she was told by Bron that he didn't want anyone to die for him. The security officer explained to Bron that people dying were serving their duty to the Count and he should accept and honor their sacrafice. The bongo was detected and was attacked by [[Hovus Jorrick]] and two other security guards in Mantas. She was able to evade their attacks long enough for Cross to return and drive off the attackers.<ref name="Hard Targets, Part 4" />

However when they go to the Serenno Spaceport, Tymon, Cross and Count Dooku were confronted by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="Hard Targets, Part 4" /> She protected the young Count from Fett, [[Hovus Jorrick]] and his security force. Before Tymon left Cross to get the Count to safety, she kissed Cross. She then stole Jorrick's speeder and made her to a ship. However, unbeknownst to her, the ''[[Imperial Diplomatic Shuttle Nine-Nine-Three]]'' was wired to blow by Cross, making Jorrick, Lord [[Rodas Borgin|Borgin]], and Fett believe the young Count was dead.<ref name="Hard Targets, Part 5" />
